$comment: Pinned runtime dependencies. They are downloaded on first run rather than
bundled in the installer: the Android SDK Platform Tools licence does not
permit redistribution, and downloading keeps the EXE small.
Every archive is verified against sha256 before it is extracted.
Run tools/Update-Deps.ps1 to refresh versions and hashes.

components.name: scrcpy
components.purpose: Native phone mirroring and control, plus a bundled adb.exe.

components.name: Android SDK Platform Tools
components.license: Android Software Development Kit License Agreement
components.purpose: Fallback source of adb.exe when the scrcpy download is unavailable. Only fetched if adb is still missing.
